translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: E yeigu agisi kwaitala tuvaila kilisala. Metoya kilisala makwaina agisi kaivasi waga kaibibiu leimaimaisi metoya oluwalaisi kwaiyu koya makwaisina barasiwokuva wala.
E waga makaina eikalumatala nabubweyani wosa eibibiasi, kaiyuwela nabubwabwau wosa,
kaitolula napupwakau wosa, kaivasila natunutunu wosa.
E yeigu akatupoi anelosi kawagu, “Mwa, avaka kala katumiki makaisina waga kaibibiu?”
E matauna ivitakaulokaigu kawala, “Ka, makaisina ikibuboti kwaivasi yagila baisa tuta wala eikaloubusisi omatala Guyoula valu watanawa komwaidona.”
E minasina wosa nabubwabwau ibibiasi makaina waga kaibibiu bilauwaisi opiliyavata mapilana Babilonia, e minasina wosa napupwakau ilolosi opilikwaibwaga, e natunutunu ilolosi mapilana opilibolimila.

E wa tuta matutona wosa minasina natunutunu isunupulasi, gala wala bipeulokaisi magisi nani bilosi ivakawolaisi valu watanawa. Anelosi ikaibiga kawala, “Kulosi kuvakawolaisi valu watanawa!” - e ka, bogwa ivagaisi goli.
Oluvi anelosi idouwaigu kawala, “Ka - minasina wosa eilosi opiliyavata isuvisi mapilana Babilonia bogwa ikatuminumwaisi la gidimleiya Guyau.”
Karaiwaga paila bisaili kala kulupaipi Yosuwa

kawala, “Kuyosi makwaisina bobwailila matausina togilagala Elidai, Tobiya deli Yedaia eisakaisi e kulau wala nani kulokaia ola bwala Yosaia matauna Sepanaia latula. Komwaidosi matausina bogwa leikaimilavausi metoya okatupipi mapilana Babilonia.
Bukuyouduli kulupaipi metoya osi bobwailila siliba deli goula, e kusaili odabala matauna Tolula Toveka, Yosuwa matauna Yeosadaki latula.
E kuluki matauna kidamwa Guyau Topeuligaga ililivala kawala, ‘Tau matauna idokaisi yagala Sisi bogwa bisiniveka ola kabosisu, e bikaliivau Guyau la Bwala Kwebumaboma.

Matauwena goli bikaliai makwaina e bogwa biboda kala kamaiaba avaka bibodi taitala guyau. E matauna biguyoi la tomota. Taitala tolula bitotu opapala la takaikaia e kasitaiyu goli bubunesi manum deli ninitinidesi bikaraiwagasi.’
E kulupaipi bisisu paila kaboluluwai olumoulela Guyau la Bwala Kwebumaboma bivigaki kasi taimamila matausina Elidai, Tobiya, Yedaia e deli Yosaia.”

Availa availa matausina si valu kaduwonaku bimaisi wala bipilasisi paila bikaliivauwaisi Guyau la Bwala Kwebumaboma. E avai tuta makwaina bogwa bikaliivauwaisi, yokomi bukunikolaisi Guyau Topeuligaga leiwitalaigu lamakaiami. Baisa komwaidona bikaloubusi makawala, kidamwa bukukwabikuwolaisi mokwita Guyau mi Yaubada la karaiwaga.
